title: Warm Springy Italian Cream Cheese Pesto
description: A fresh and light Italian dish featuring cream cheese, soffritto-base, and pesto, served warm on a comal, perfect for springtime.
instructions: Preheat the comal over medium heat.
In a food processor, combine the softened cream cheese, chopped basil, minced garlic, and toasted pine nuts.
Process the mixture until it is well combined and the basil is finely chopped.
Add the grated parmesan cheese, kosher salt, and freshly ground black pepper to the food processor.
Process the mixture until it is smooth and creamy.
With the food processor running, slowly pour in the extra virgin olive oil and freshly squeezed lemon juice.
Continue processing the mixture until it is well combined and has a pesto-like consistency.
Transfer the pesto mixture to a serving bowl and place it on the warm comal.
Serve the Warm Springy Italian Cream Cheese Pesto immediately, garnished with additional chopped basil if desired.
